# SasaVenos Recommends Training Isometric Skills At 80 To 90 Percent Of One Rep Max Using A Rubber Band That Takes Off Five To Nine Kilograms

SasaVenos recommends training isometric skills at 80 to 90 percent of one rep max, using only a rubber band that takes away five to nine kilograms, and not doing more than 20 to 30 reps or 30 to 40 seconds of volume per session. [src: vid-krqBQjUydGY]

## Details

- He says to change progressions of a skill that is in 80 to 90 percent of your one rep max. [src: vid-krqBQjUydGY]
- Use only a rubber band that takes away five to nine kilograms. [src: vid-krqBQjUydGY]
- Do not do more than 20 to 30 reps or 30 to 40 seconds of volume per session. [src: vid-krqBQjUydGY]
- If the volume sounds like too little, decrease the rest between sets until you are doing it efficiently. [src: vid-krqBQjUydGY]
- Apply progressive overload to your sets and try to work a little bit harder every week, but do not increase the volume. [src: vid-krqBQjUydGY]
- He trained rings twice per week, only around 10 sets of holds per week. [src: vid-krqBQjUydGY]

## Evidence

- vid-krqBQjUydGY (SasaVenos): "i decide to drop my ego and go for a different approach where i will only perform movements and isometrics that are in my 80 to 90 percent rep max"
- vid-krqBQjUydGY (SasaVenos): "i train rings twice per week only around 10 sets of holds per week and i got from 8.5 seconds with band to 11 seconds of body with maltese hold in just five weeks"
- vid-krqBQjUydGY (SasaVenos): "but this is my conclusion change progressions of a skill that's in 80 to 90 percent of your one rep max use only the rubber band that takes away five to nine kilograms"
- vid-krqBQjUydGY (SasaVenos): "don't do more than 20 to 30 reps or 30 to 40 seconds of volume per session"
- vid-krqBQjUydGY (SasaVenos): "if it sounds like too little then decrease the rest between sets until you're doing it super efficiently and quickly apply progressive overload to your sets try to work a little bit harder every week but do not increase the volume"

## Example From The Source

In his own five-week test, he went from 8.5 seconds with a light band to 11 seconds of bodyweight maltese hold. [src: vid-krqBQjUydGY]
